summary: Executed final backend+frontend verification for QuickPrint mobile redesign scope. Backend auth/template contracts largely passed, but frontend QuickPrint acceptance flow is blocked in this environment because the requested vehicle-details print entrypoint is not reachable (route falls back to dashboard), preventing full end-to-end validation of template switch and output-channel parity.

critical.issue: Credentialed login response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while credentials are used. This violates browser credentialed-CORS rules and can cause auth/session instability across real browser contexts.

issues: Floating assistant FAB and bottom floating controls visually compete with content area and can reduce clarity of primary actions on small viewport.

action_items: Fix credentialed CORS behavior at edge/proxy so Access-Control-Allow-Origin is explicit origin (not '*') when credentials are enabled.
Restore/verify reachable vehicle-details print entrypoint for mobile validation path used in acceptance criteria.

After route/entrypoint is fixed, re-run full QuickPrint mobile checks for: no perpetual loading on current template, exact main actions (WhatsApp/PDF/Print), Bottom Sheet select+close behavior, 390px preview modal overflow check, and selectedTemplateId parity in /use + output channels.

QuickPrintDialog currently keeps preview modal structure, but there is no guaranteed user-accessible trigger in tested runtime path once vehicle-details route is not reached; this blocks the required acceptance flow.
No MOCKED APIs detected in this run; checks were executed against integrated public preview endpoints.

RCA-2 (frontend integration/runtime): targeted vehicle-details route is not effectively reachable post-login in this environment, so QuickPrint entrypoint selectors do not render and acceptance flow cannot execute.
